item.title: One Last Stop at Cactus Rock: The JomezPro Series Finale Preview
item.description:
The 2026 disc golf season wraps up with the JomezPro Series Finale at Cactus Rock, and the Disc Golf Pro Tour has published its preview of the top storylines and how to watch. The finale is the last stop of the year, the final chance for players to make a statement before the offseason.

Finales carry extra weight: season-long narratives get settled, players fighting for ranking position or momentum have one more event, and the coverage itself is a showcase for the sport's biggest stage. The preview is the place to check start times, broadcast details, and which players and plotlines to follow as the season closes.

item.title: What disc weight should you throw? A guide to picking the right grams
item.description:
The same disc golf disc can come in weights from around 150g to 175g, and that number genuinely changes how it flies. Heavier discs need more power to get up to speed but hold their line better in wind; lighter discs are easier to throw far but get pushed around more and turn over sooner.

The practical takeaway: newer players and those still building arm speed usually benefit from lighter discs, while stronger throwers can lean on max-weight discs for consistency and wind resistance. If your drives are turning over unexpectedly or stalling out, your disc weight — not just the mold — may be the culprit.

Sources

  • Foundation Disc Golf - Blog: What Disc Golf Weight Should I Throw?
